# Synthetic PC and Parts profile fixtures

These laptop and monitor records were authored for offline tests on 17 November
2026. They are not captured listings, actual prices, validated shipping quotes or
evidence of current retailer metadata. The shared SKU is a test identifier scoped
to each independent fixture. No network request was made to produce them.

The profile exercises exact item/part/configuration binding, online stock,
item-level tax inclusion, and a destination-specific base shipping rate with
packaged weight. Complete shipping costs and item eligibility remain unresolved.
